name: How Do You Compare Room Addition Bids Without Hidden Costs?

mainEntity.name: How do I compare bids for a room addition in Los Angeles County without missing hidden costs?
mainEntity.text: How do I compare bids for a room addition in Los Angeles County without missing hidden costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: To compare room addition bids correctly, you need to make sure each contractor is pricing the same scope. Look at what is included for demolition, framing, foundation, roofing, insulation, windows, drywall, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, permits, engineering, and final cleanup. Also check allowances for finishes, because a low allowance can make a bid look cheaper than it really is. Exclusions matter just as much as inclusions. For example, one bid may exclude site protection, utility upgrades, or permit revisions, which can create substantial add-ons later. Ask for line-item or clearly broken-out pricing so you can compare apples to apples. A contractor who explains assumptions and likely risk items is often providing a more reliable estimate than one who only gives a lump sum. The goal is not to choose the cheapest number, but to understand the real project cost before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare bids by checking scope, allowances, exclusions, structural work, finishes, permits, demolition, and site cleanup. The lowest bid is not always the best value if it leaves out engineering, utility upgrades, or finish details. Request a line-item breakdown so each proposal can be evaluated on the same basis.
